title: Fantasy football
summary: Weekly start/sit calls for a real fantasy football roster, from six projection sources merged into one consensus, plus waivers, trades, projection checks and draft prep.
when: who to start or sit, a fantasy lineup, waiver pickups, a trade offer, how projections held up, or draft rankings
askFirst: The league: a Sleeper username, a Yahoo team link, an ESPN league link, or a roster screenshot or paste.
Scoring (PPR, half-PPR or standard) and lineup slots (for example QB, 2 RB, 2 WR, TE, FLEX, SUPERFLEX, K, DST) when the league read does not show them.
The week, if not the current one.

recipes.title: Who to start this week
recipes.when: Lineup decisions for the current or a named week.

steps.do: Read the roster, scoring and slots. Yahoo public team: public_team_roster with team_url. Sleeper: firecrawl_scrape the public API (api.sleeper.app/v1/user/{username}, then /v1/user/{user_id}/leagues/nfl/{season}, /v1/league/{league_id} for scoring_settings and roster_positions, and /rosters). ESPN or private leagues: use the user's screenshot or paste.

For each rostered position, pull this week's projections from every source in the league's scoring. Scoring options differ by source (CBS Sports has no half-PPR; FFToday has no DST), so map the format per contract. Batch up to 10 calls per firecrawl_scrape.
Check the injury and practice report for rostered players.
Merge by player: consensus = mean projected points across the sources that cover the player, with rank spread and source count. Fill the real slots from highest consensus, FLEX and SUPERFLEX last.
Top 3 free agents: Yahoo public league with status FA; otherwise the best consensus players not on the roster, asking the user to confirm they are available.

recipes.output: Start and sit for each lineup slot with one line on why (consensus points, source agreement, injury), close calls flagged where sources disagree, then the top 3 free agents worth adding.

recipes.title: Waiver wire
recipes.when: Who to pick up or drop.

steps.do: Rank the available players against rest-of-season boards (CBS Sports with type ros).
Check injuries; for a Yahoo public league, list status FA players.

recipes.output: Ranked adds with a matching drop for each, one line of reasoning per move.

recipes.title: Trade check

steps.do: Line up both sides against rest-of-season and season-long projections.

recipes.output: Projected points given and received, the verdict, and what would make the offer fair.

recipes.title: How projections held up
recipes.when: Comparing last week's projections with actual scores.

steps.do: Pull projected versus actual points for the week.

recipes.output: Biggest hits and misses per source for the user's players.

recipes.title: Draft prep
recipes.when: Rankings and average draft position before a draft.

steps.do: Pull ADP for the league's scoring and size, then season-long projections.

recipes.output: Value picks and reaches by round, by comparing ADP with projections.

rules: Use the league's scoring in every call, and say when a source lacks that format or position.
Every number comes from a named source; never fill a missing projection. Report source errors.
Discovery is free. Each capability lists its credit price in firecrawl_find_tools; a lineup is roughly one call per source per position, so give the estimate before a large run.
